prompts.plains: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for a dark fantasy 1990s RTS illustrated world map. Exactly 12 isolated sprites, regular FOUR columns THREE rows equal cells. Each sprite occupies only central 65% of its cell, generous completely transparent gutters. No text/grid/background/rectangular terrain tiles. Camera VERY DISTANT high overhead orthographic, a whole sprite depicts several kilometres of countryside. Fine painterly pixel-compatible texture, diffuse upper-left light, muted ochre straw grass, grey olive heath, dusty brown soil, soft grey stone. Moderate value range. Crucially depict CONTINUOUS LOW COUNTRY AT REGIONAL SCALE, not miniature hills or piles of stones. No large rocks, cliffs, repeated zigzag ridges, dune chains, giant individual shrubs, regular farm plots, roads or buildings. Each piece an asymmetrical broad flat landscape fragment with irregular dissolving scattered edges, feathered natural vegetation into transparency. Tiny numerous details within the mass, low vertical relief, no thick dark outline. Row 1: four distinct expansive low grassland folds with delicate sweeping drainage patterns, one long shallow valley, one broad rolling shoulder, one curved heath-covered rise, one branching shallow depression. Row 2: four narrow transition pieces: broken low grass escarpment; meandering scrub-lined hollow; thin irregular meadow hedgerow of dozens of minuscule shrubs; concave meadow edge for a settlement clearing. Row 3: four low sparse fringes: heath mosaic; dry meadow with tiny ground speckling; sparse scrub ribbons; stone-grass transition with stones scarcely individually discernible. Entire sheet composition: 12 fully separate coherent landscape silhouettes, not repetition of the same shape. Artwork designed to read as distant land texture plus gentle forms at ~64 pixels across per sprite. Genuine alpha transparency.
prompts.forest:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for a dark fantasy 1990s RTS illustrated regional world map. Exactly 12 fully isolated pieces in FOUR columns and THREE rows equal cells. Keep every piece completely within central 65% of its own cell, generous empty TRANSPARENT gutters. No text, grids, background, rectangular plates. VERY DISTANT overhead orthographic camera with slight oblique relief: each large piece depicts kilometres of woodland, HUNDREDS of tiny trees. Canopy should read like fine mottled carpet with subtle relief, NOT a handful of giant broccoli crowns or separate hero trees. No visible large trunks, no big boulders. Fine hand-painted pixel-compatible terrain, top-left diffuse light, moderate contrast muted olive and grey-green with dusty bronze, soft brown undergrowth. Dark fantasy temperate woodland, not tropical or bright emerald. Irregular natural silhouettes with broken tapering edges, no black outline or ground pedestal. Row1 four substantial continuous forestry masses: asymmetrical broad dense woodland; elongated woodland watershed; branching canopy wrapping narrow open glades; low wooded shoulder with many tiny crowns. Row2 four linking forest edge pieces: long ragged treeline; concave woodland edge framing open settlement clearing; gently curving shallow wooded ravine; narrow wooded bank. Row3 four sparse small-footprint fringes: tiny young scrub with bare gaps; low sparse woodland edge; a wispy curved copse; thin groundcover and sapling transition. Keep all trees at same MINUSCULE scale throughout, each piece built of very many small crown marks, well above a tactical battle camera. No water, buildings, roads, mountains, circular identical clumps. Pieces must overlap into broad coherent irregular forests. Genuine transparent alpha.
CRITICAL LAYOUT override: use a SQUARE canvas. All 12 pieces must be SHORT AND WIDE not tall. Each of the 3 rows has equal height. First row: four compact horizontally elongated dense canopy carpets, absolutely no tall S-shaped pieces. All sprites have width about twice height. Leave at least 25% of each cell height blank above and below each piece. Omit any backdrop completely, alpha zero between sprites.

import: Forest sheet has a blank header; importer crops top 24% before extracting 4x3 cells. Original master is preserved. Runtime widths 64/48/32. Ground texture sampling restored to original frequency.
